mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for three consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates broad-based demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During post-shock recovery, a sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 index level signals improving manufacturing activity that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO exceeds 105.0 during post-shock recovery, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction (HOUST) above 1200.0 thousand units signals strong housing market activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST exceeds 1200.0 thousand units, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption (RSAFS) falls below 440,000 million dollars for two consecutive months, it indicates consumer spending contraction that reduces corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS falls below 440000 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
